answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit milestone bond and registers a wander route past three cedar posts. Each post needs a fresh signed log; a prism seal splits the route hash in three receipts, and an auditor recombines them to verify each log. A missing or rented log breaks the seal and burns the bond. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 locked plus 120,000 in fresh logs, for at most 40,000 rewards. An honest agent pays 60 once, keeps full shares.
